verdict.rationale: Scheduling recurring jobs is a fair question for a cloud browser-automation platform, but the evidence pack shows no scheduling, cron, or recurring-workflow feature. The docs only describe one-off actions: starting tasks with a single API call, single scrape and crawl requests, and sandbox exec calls. A one-off action is not a recurring schedule, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
